finding.title: Localize the hardcoded 'Order' AppBar title in LearningOrderScreen
finding.rule: AX-2 (no hardcoded user-facing strings; EN/HE ARB parity)
finding.why: This @RoutePage() screen is live (wired in app_router.gr.dart) and its AppBar title concatenates a raw English 'Order' literal onto the curriculum label — in Hebrew locale a user sees the Hebrew curriculum name followed by untranslated English 'Order' instead of a fully localized title. The sibling screen for the identical concept, TrackLearningOrderScreen, does this correctly via AppLocalizations.of(context)!.trackReorderScreenTitle(...), which already has both EN ('{curriculum} • Reorder') and HE ('{curriculum} • סדר מחדש') ARB entries this screen could reuse.
finding.recommendation: Replace the string concatenation with AppLocalizations.of(context)!.trackReorderScreenTitle(curriculumLabelText(...)) or a dedicated new ARB key if the titles must differ.
acceptance_criteria: No raw non-ARB string literals remain in learning_order_screen.dart's AppBar title
Hebrew-locale widget test asserts the AppBar title contains no Latin-script 'Order' substring
